label: Create notebook
summary: Makes an empty notebook with a title and a look.
aiDescription: Creates a new empty notebook. Use first when the goal needs a new notebook; later steps add pages, cards and databases with the notebookId it returns. Does not write pages. Do not use to add to an existing notebook.

label: Create notebook from a spec
summary: Makes a whole notebook (pages, cards) from one written spec.
aiDescription: Creates a new notebook with all its pages, blocks and recall cards in one step, from a complete ln-spec/1 spec. Use when you already have all the content. For step-by-step building use notebooks.create and then pages.write_notes. Never changes existing notebooks.

spec.description: A notebook spec: { version: "ln-spec/1", title, summary?, style?, pages: [...], cards?: [...] }.

label: Write notes
summary: Adds a page of notes to a notebook.
aiDescription: Adds one page of notes to a notebook. Needs notebookId (from an earlier step or the destination). Send a short brief, or the full page when you already have the content. Do not use for cards or databases; chain the other tools.

label: Make recall cards
summary: Turns the notes into question and answer cards.
aiDescription: Adds question and answer cards to an existing page, under its Recall cards heading. Needs pageId from an earlier step. Give cards, or a count and a brief. For fill-in-the-blank cards use cards.make_cloze. Not for quizzes.

label: Make fill-in-the-blank cards
summary: Turns the notes into cards with hidden words.
aiDescription: Adds fill-in-the-blank cards to an existing page, under its Recall cards heading. Each card text hides words as {{word}}. Needs pageId from an earlier step. Give cards, or a count and a brief. For question and answer cards use cards.make_recall.

label: Create database
summary: Adds a table of rows with three starter views.
aiDescription: Adds one database (columns and rows) to a notebook, with three starter views, and can show it at the end of a page. Needs notebookId from an earlier step. Give the database, or a brief. Use for lists with fields; use pages for prose.

label: Apply style
summary: Changes the cover colour, view or paper of a notebook or page.
aiDescription: Changes the look of an existing notebook: cover colour, shelf or tabs view, path style, paper size and lines. Can set one page tab colour. Needs notebookId. Changes values only; never touches content. Not for writing notes.

label: Refine page
summary: Improves a page block by block, keeping a History copy.
aiDescription: Edits an existing page one block at a time: add, insert after a block, or replace a block. A copy goes to History first. Big changes wait in the Inbox for Accept. Needs pageId. Give ops, or a brief. Never deletes pages.

label: Rename page
summary: Gives an existing page a new title.
aiDescription: Changes the title of one existing page. Needs pageId (from an earlier step or the destination) and the new title. Changes the title only; never touches the content. Not for writing or tidying notes.

label: Rename tab
summary: Gives a notebook tab its own name.
aiDescription: Renames one tab of an existing notebook (tabs are notes, summary, database, cards, revise). Needs notebookId and tabId. Changes the name only; never touches the pages. Not for hiding a tab.

label: Show or hide tab
summary: Hides a notebook tab, or shows it again.
aiDescription: Hides or shows one tab of an existing notebook. Hidden tabs keep everything inside and can be shown again. Needs notebookId, tabId and hidden (true or false). Never deletes a tab. Not for renaming.

label: Write summary
summary: Sets the short summary of a lesson page.
aiDescription: Sets the short summary shown on a top-level lesson page. Needs pageId. Send a brief, or the finished summary text when you already have it. Replaces the old summary (History keeps it). Not for notes or cards.

label: Add mind map
summary: Adds an editable mind map to a page.
aiDescription: Adds one mind map block at the end of an existing page. Needs pageId. Send a brief, or the finished outline: an indented list where the first line is the central topic and each deeper level is indented by two spaces. The map stays editable (never a picture). Not for notes or cards.

label: Change mind map colours
summary: Changes the colour theme of a mind map.
aiDescription: Sets the colour theme of one existing mind map block: calm, bold or paper. Needs blockId (the mind map block). Changes only the theme, never the topics. Not for adding a map.

label: Set a card aside
summary: Sets a card aside from reviews, or brings it back.
aiDescription: Suspends or brings back one existing recall card. Needs cardId and suspended (true or false). A suspended card stays saved and keeps its history but never appears in reviews. Never deletes a card and never edits its text.

label: Rename database
summary: Gives a database a new title.
aiDescription: Changes the title of one existing database. Needs databaseId (from an earlier step) and the new title. Changes the title only; never touches columns, rows or views. The Study tracker cannot be renamed.

label: Change paper
summary: Sets the paper behind the drawing on a page.
aiDescription: Sets the paper behind the ink of one existing page: plain, lined, grid or dots. Needs pageId and paper. Changes only the paper; never touches notes or drawings. Not for notebook colours (use styles.apply).

label: Change page path
summary: Sets how the path above a page is shown.
aiDescription: Sets how the path above one existing page is shown: simple, full or page. Use inherit to follow the notebook again. Needs pageId and pathStyle. Changes only that page; never touches notes. Not for notebook-wide styles.
